caption: A quiet, rain-soaked street corner near a train station, where neon reflections shimmer on wet pavement and parked cars add to the subdued urban atmosphere. It's a rainy night at a street corner near a train station, indicated by the "KTX" sign on the building. The wet pavement reflects the streetlights and neon signs, creating a shimmering effect. Several white cars are parked or driving slowly through the intersection. A small shelter with scooters parked nearby stands on the right side of the frame. The overall atmosphere is quiet and subdued, with the rain adding a sense of calm and solitude to the urban scene.
